## What's Changed

## Subscribe to GitHub Event Streams with `gh event` (preview)

The new `gh event` command set lets agents, integrations, and scripts wait for pull request changes instead of polling GitHub:

```shell
# Wait for a review event
gh event listen --resource https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/NUMBER --event com.github.pull_request.review.submitted.v1 --timeout 30m

# Wait for a check suite completion event
gh event listen --resource https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/NUMBER --event com.github.pull_request.check_suite.status.changed.v1 --jq .data.conclusion

# List active event subscriptions
gh event subscription list
```

By default, `gh event listen` exits after the first event. Use `--count` to wait for several events or `--follow` to keep listening. Events are printed as CloudEvent JSON objects, with `data.api_url` pointing to the resource that changed.

Supported events include submitted reviews, pull request state and head changes, merge conflicts, and completed check suites. The `subscription create`, `list`, `view`, and `delete` commands manage subscriptions directly.

> [!NOTE]
> GitHub Event Streams is in preview. [Join the wait list](https://gh.io/event-streams-signup), read the [announcement](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-17-github-event-streams-is-now-in-preview), or see the [Event Streams documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/integrations/how-tos/using-github-event-streams).

## What's Changed

### ✨ Features

* Add a server-sent events reader and Event Subscriptions API client by @babakks in [#15071](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15071)
* Add `gh event listen` to wait for pull request events without polling by @babakks in [#15072](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15072)
* Add `gh event subscription list` by @babakks in [#15073](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15073)
* Add `gh event subscription create` by @babakks in [#15074](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15074)
* Add `gh event subscription view` by @babakks in [#15075](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15075)
* Add `gh event subscription delete` by @babakks in [#15076](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15076)
* Suggest `gh event listen` to agents using `gh pr` and `gh api` by @babakks in [#15077](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15077)
* Support check suite events and suggest them from `gh run view` and `gh run watch` by @babakks in [#15081](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15081)

### 🐛 Fixes

* fix(event listen): print each event without waiting for the next heartbeat by @babakks and @iancanderson in [#15079](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15079)
* fix(event listen): report deleted subscriptions clearly by @babakks in [#15080](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15080)
* fix(event): improve stream framing, `Retry-After` handling, evals, and regression coverage by @babakks in [#15083](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15083)

### 📚 Docs & Chores

* Make issue-triage formatting checks nonblocking by @BagToad in [#15052](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15052)
* Add event-driven agent evals, `gh` skill guidance, and preview documentation by @babakks in [#15078](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15078)

### :dependabot: Dependencies

* chore(deps): bump `golang.org/x/text` from 0.43.0 to 0.44.0 by @dependabot in [#15049](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15049)
* chore(deps): bump `golang.org/x/term` from 0.47.0 to 0.48.0 by @dependabot in [#15048](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15048)
* chore(deps): bump `golang.org/x/crypto` from 0.58.0 to 0.59.0 by @dependabot in [#15064](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15064)
* chore(deps): bump `zod` from 4.3.6 to 4.6.6 in `evals` by @dependabot in [#15086](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15086)
* chore(deps): bump `@hono/node-server` from 2.1.5 to 2.1.9 in `evals` by @dependabot in [#15085](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15085)
* chore(deps): bump `hono` from 4.13.13 to 4.13.19 in `evals` by @dependabot in [#15084](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15084)
